The '''Solassus system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match]], a [[gladiator walker]] competition.<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Solassus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
